title: how to clone a subaccount dashboard
text:
Efficiently reuse your existing dashboards and save valuable time by leveraging the cloning feature. This guide will walk you through the steps to successfully clone a dashboard.
TABLE OF CONTENTS
 [#Dashboard-Clone] Dashboard Clone
 [#Step-1%3A-Open-A-Dashboard] Step 1: Open A Dashboard
 [#Step-2%3A-Clone-The-Dashboard] Step 2: Clone The Dashboard
 [#Step-3%3A-Configure-and-Save-Dashboard-Clone] Step 3: Configure and Save Dashboard Clone
 [#What's-Next%3A] What's Next:
Dashboard Clone

Step 1: Open A Dashboard

Navigate to Subaccount > Dashboard and click on the dashboard selection menu. Search or browse for your target dashboard. Select it to open for viewing and editing.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044573427/original/SabBltMQD22qnDtAa81ooJp0HJUWRRLghQ.png?1743804171] 

Step 2: Clone The Dashboard

On the original-dashboard, click the action menu (3 dots) and click the clone button.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044573391/original/7QxGqD4lg8IgpiqZmBFyvs4K7HMBNSF2ew.png?1743803929] 

Step 3: Configure and Save Dashboard Clone

In the Clone Dashboard modal, write the cloned-dashboard title, set the dashboard's privacy/access permissions, then click the Clone button. This will create the new cloned-dashboard with the appropriate settings.

 [image:  https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044573401/original/lzYJqJReqAwa75pXQ5EGJ9wnffGvqI7J1g.png?1743804027]
